stages.text: Accept Sela Cordova's offer to show you around.
Walk around the concourse - WASD or the arrow keys.
Target one of the people here - press [ or ] to cycle, or click them.

one_way_message.text: See everyone around us? Tap [ or ] to cycle a target lock, or just click someone. Their name and role show up top-right.

stages.text: Walk up to someone and talk - press T.

one_way_message.text: Get in close to anyone and press T to talk. Shopkeepers open their store; everyone else has something to say.

stages.text: Open your Mission Log - press N.

one_way_message.text: Press N for your Mission Log. Every step I give you is listed there, so you'll never have to guess what's next.
Now press P for your Possessions - credits, ships, cargo, outfits. Pretty bare right now. Let's fix that.

stages.text: Scroll back through the Message Log - mouse wheel while pointing at the bottom-left pane.

one_way_message.text: Piling up a few comms? Everything I send lands in the Message Log, bottom-left. Point at that pane and roll the mouse wheel to scroll back through it - the blue arrows show when there's more above or below.

stages.text: Go to the Credit Union (west pod) and take the starter loan from Petra Voss.

one_way_message.text: Head west off the concourse to the Credit Union. Talk to Petra Voss and take the station's starter loan - you'll need the credits for a ship.

stages.text: Go to the Ship Dock (east pod) and buy a ship from Dax Renner.

one_way_message.text: Now the Ship Dock, east side. Dax Renner has a few hulls for sale - buy whichever you like. The shuttle's an easy first ship.

stages.text: You're flight-ready - board your ship through the Ship Dock portal (L).

one_way_message.text: That's everything. Your ship's docked and waiting - step on the Ship Dock portal and press L to board when you're ready. Come find me if you're ever back this way. Good luck out there, pilot.

stages.text: Cycle your targeting mode (T) until it reads SHIPS.
Cycle your target ([ or ]) until you're targeting Kade Marsh, then hail him (H).

one_way_message.text: Nice, SHIPS mode. Now cycle your target with [ or ] until you're locked onto me, then hit H and let's talk.

stages.text: Talk to Kade Marsh - he's offering to show you the ropes.
Turn your ship both ways - left (A / Left arrow), then right (D / Right arrow).

one_way_message.text: Alright, let's start simple. Turn left with A or the left arrow, then right with D or the right arrow - give me both so I know your thrusters are good.

stages.text: Thrust forward - W or the Up arrow.

one_way_message.text: Good. Now hold W or the up arrow to thrust forward. Watch your speed build - space doesn't slow you down on its own.

stages.text: Turn around and brake until your speed drops - S or the Down arrow, then thrust.

one_way_message.text: Now the fun part - turning around. Hold S or the down arrow to point opposite your velocity, then thrust to cancel it out. Get your speed down.

stages.text: Fly far from the system center, wait for the drift prompt, then jump home (J).

one_way_message.text: Nicely done. Jumping needs room - fly well clear of the system center until a prompt tells you you've drifted far enough. Your current system is already the default jump target, so from there just tap J to warp home. When you want to travel somewhere else, open the Star Map (M) first and pick your destination.

stages.text: Target the station/moon (T for LANDABLES, then [ ]), autopilot in (Space), land (L).

one_way_message.text: You're a fast learner. Last thing - landing. Tap T to cycle your target mode: SHIPS for ships, LANDABLES for stations and moons, MISC for the rest. Set it to LANDABLES, then [ or ] to pick the station or moon. With it targeted, hit Space and the autopilot flies you in and sets you down - or fly it yourself and press L once you're close and slow. Good luck out there, pilot.
